issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Asad Ahmed Adow (Leo Human Services, HSS) - Plea Agreement, ECF 14
supports: Asad Ahmed Adow agrees he owes restitution of $2,710,832 and agrees to forfeit seized U.S. currency of $48,600, $14,760 and $25,000 from a Blaine, Minnesota residence.
He consents to a money judgment forfeiture of $2,827,281, with credit for forfeited property.
does_not_support: A plea agreement states agreed amounts; it is not a restitution order or a forfeiture order, and no judgment for this defendant is captured.
The same three seized-currency items are also listed in Anwar Adow's plea agreement (0:25-cr-00353, ECF 9); they are one pool of seized cash, not two.
Seized property is credited against the money judgment; the figures must not be summed.
